Create a review-only 2D GAME PROP SPRITE SHEET for Great Voyage. Landscape 1536x1024, exactly six isolated objects in a 3-column x 2-row layout, generous transparent gutters, centered inside conceptual 512x512 cells. Bottom row (4) rectangular timber plank floor panel, (5) straight horizontal flush-ended wooden partition segment without terminal posts, (6) simple wood chair with navy cloth seat. Brown wood, navy fabric, ivory paper, restrained brass accents. Do not add objects or human parts. True transparent background; no cast shadow clouds, checkerboard, colored backdrop, text, watermark, frames or labels. All six fully visible with no overlap. STYLE A — EXISTING FACTORY PAINTERLY APPROACH: Hand-Painted 2D Game Art, Stylized Painterly Illustration, Textured Shading, Organic Color Variation, Material-Specific Surface Details. The two supplied maritime/harbor sheets are references for painted materials and surface rendering ONLY; do not import their objects, viewpoint or composition. Simplify basic silhouettes but retain directional grain, restrained knots/worn timber edges, fine matte cloth folds and dye variation, irregular brass tone/reflections and small patina accents. Thin consistent SINGLE dark contours, no double black rims or edge bleed, no bulky frames/exaggerated corners, reduce excessive side exposure and deep shadows. Natural painterly surface tonal transitions are allowed, no smooth digital gradients, no plastic/chibi/sticker rendering, no clean vector fill. Gentle coherent upper-left light. Readable painterly surfaces at game scale, no photorealistic microtexture. This is A of a two-style comparison, not a claim of approval.
